add.evidence: On 21 July 1975 he resigned, along with his deputy Ricardo Zinn.

add.event: Antonio Cafiero 出任经济部长，但未能扭转经济颓势
add.evidence: On 11 August 1975, Antonio Cafiero assumed office as minister, but failed to alter the catastrophic course of the economy
the inflation rate rose from 24.4% in 1974 to 182.4% in 1975 and 444% in 1976
